itemized.escalation_note: ADDENDUM G2 (value overflows its printed column) OCCURRED ON BOTH SCHEDULES. A 900 dpi crop bounded on the amount column's own detected rules (82.47->92.24 on p2, 82.35->92.05 on p3) CLIPPED the last digit of both figures, rendering '605.2'. Re-rendered with the box widened to x=82.0 w=15.0, both cells render '605.20' in full. Each of the two transcribed rows therefore carries an EXPLICIT WIDENED geometry string, which wins over the page frame; the frames still record the honest measurement of the printed grid.

geometry.provenance: printed-rule detection on the rendered page (scripts/campaign_finance/rowbands.py, raw-render frame): per-page frame = the Amount column band x one measured band per printed table row; a row's box is their intersection, in pct of the page as poppler renders it (rotation included)

itemized.notes: STEPHEN "HEMI" HEMINGWAY, page-face office 'UTAH COUNTY CLERK/AUDITOR', party 'REPUBLICAN'; index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the PAGE FACE governs and the coordinator may promote the name through office_overrides.csv (the Ainge precedent). 4 pages, legacy_colAB, cover ALL-CAPS handwriting: p1 cover ('30 Days after withdraw or elimination', not an amendment, signed 4/29/2018), p2 SCHEDULE A, p3 SCHEDULE B, p4 SUMMARY PAGE. *** THE SUMMARY PAGE IS THE LAST PAGE, NOT p2. *** On this filing the two schedules come BEFORE the summary - the exact reason the brief says to locate the summary page by CONTENT and never by ordinal (the module's own variant table predicts p2 for legacy_colAB).
